srv1_desc: Setup, manage, and optimize ad campaigns across various digital platforms, focusing on business goals and KPIs.
srv1_benefit: Maximize reach and visibility to the right audience with high efficiency and low cost.
srv2_desc: Build an ad strategy focusing on the entire customer journey, from ad impression to engagement and purchase.
srv2_benefit: Transform ad budget into tangible results and scalable sales growth.
srv3_desc: Setup tracking tools to understand traffic sources, customer behavior, and measure conversions accurately.
srv3_benefit: Precise tracking of every dollar spent and 100% accuracy in the purchase funnel.
srv4_desc: Analyze campaign metrics to discover what works and what needs improvement, then make data-driven decisions.
srv4_benefit: Stop financial waste instantly and allocate budget towards the most profitable campaigns.
principle_1_d: I analyze the target audience, study market competitors, examine the product/service, and develop a marketing offer to ensure ad strength.
principle_2_d: Drafting the ad message and selecting the right content to match the landing page, smoothing the customer journey.
analytics_title: Data is the foundation for better decisions
analytics_subtitle: Without accurate measurement, sustainable growth is impossible. I build a strong tracking infrastructure to understand sources and behavior.
tracking_goal: Tracking aims to answer: Where did the customer come from? What did they do? Where did the conversion happen?
kpi_cpm_d: Measures the cost of showing the ad 1,000 times to the target audience.
kpi_ctr_d: Measures audience interest and engagement with the ad content.
kpi_cpc_d: Measures the actual cost for each visitor clicking the ad link.
kpi_cpl_d: Cost paid for acquiring contact information of an interested customer.
kpi_cpa_d: Cost paid for a completed sale or final conversion event.
kpi_cr_d: Percentage of visitors who actually complete the desired conversion.
kpi_roas_d: Revenue generated relative to the ad budget spent.
kpi_rev_d: Total sales and profits generated after running the ads.

skills_subtitle: The marketing and analytical skills I rely on for digital campaign success.
